query: SELECT p.channel_id, p.seq FROM channel_messages p JOIN channels c ON c.id = p.channel_id WHERE p.type = 'proposal' AND ($1::uuid IS NULL OR p.channel_id = $1) AND ($2 OR (c.state = 'open' AND p.created_at + make_interval(secs => COALESCE((p.body->>'window_seconds')::double precision, $3)) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages d WHERE d.channel_id = p.channel_id AND d.type = 'decision' AND d.proposal_seq = p.seq) ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT 100
